messageValues.message:
You are the intent-and-entity extraction layer for the business WhatsApp sales assistant.

Given the customer's latest message and up to 3 prior turns of conversation history for context, return ONLY a JSON object â€” no prose, no markdown â€” matching this schema:

{
  "intent": "PRODUCT_INQUIRY | PRICE_CHECK | AVAILABILITY_CHECK | OFFER_REQUEST | BULK_ORDER | DELIVERY_QUESTION | ORDER_CONFIRMATION | COMPLAINT | HUMAN_HANDOFF_REQUEST | GENERAL_QUESTION",
  "confidence": <float 0-1>,
  "entities": {
    "product_name": <string or null>,
    "product_category": <string or null>,
    "quantity": <integer or null>,
    "variant": <string or null>,
    "budget": <number or null>
  },
  "language": "<ISO 639-1 code>"
}

Rules:
- A quantity of 10 or more units MUST be classified as BULK_ORDER.
- If the customer is specifying a size, color, or variant for a product discussed in the conversation history (e.g. "S size black color" or "polo"), include the referenced product_name from the history so context is preserved.
- If confidence < 0.6, still return best guess; downstream handles escalation.
- COMPLAINT always escalates regardless of confidence.

- IMPORTANT: If Customer State is 'CHECKOUT' and the customer says 'ok', 'yes', 'buy now', or provides an address, you MUST classify as ORDER_CONFIRMATION.

parameters.query:
WITH RankedProducts AS (
  SELECT
    id, name, description, price, category, stock, variants, image_url, tags,
    CASE 
      -- 1. Exact or partial match on name, category, or tags
      WHEN LENGTH('{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? "" }}') > 0 AND (
        name ILIKE '%' || RTRIM('{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? "" }}', 's') || '%'
        OR category ILIKE '%' || RTRIM('{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? "" }}', 's') || '%'
        OR '{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? "" }}' = ANY(tags)
      ) THEN 0
      WHEN LENGTH('{{ $json.entities?.product_category ?? "" }}') > 0 AND (
        category ILIKE '%' || RTRIM('{{ $json.entities?.product_category ?? "" }}', 's') || '%'
        OR name ILIKE '%' || RTRIM('{{ $json.entities?.product_category ?? "" }}', 's') || '%'
      ) THEN 0
      WHEN to_tsvector('english', name || ' ' || description || ' ' || category) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', '{{ $json.entities?.product_name || $json.entities?.product_category || $json.messageText || "all" }}') THEN 1
      WHEN 'best seller' = ANY(tags) THEN 2
      ELSE 3
    END AS match_rank
  FROM products
  WHERE
    business_id = '{{ $json.business_id }}'
    AND is_active = true
)
SELECT id, name, description, price, category, stock, variants, image_url, tags 
FROM RankedProducts
WHERE match_rank <= 2
ORDER BY match_rank ASC, stock DESC
LIMIT 4;

parameters.query:
-- Â§10.3 Node 1: Fetch matching products by category or name
SELECT id, name, description, price, category, stock, variants, image_url, tags
FROM products
WHERE
  business_id = '{{ $json.business_id }}'
  AND is_active = true
  AND stock > 0
  AND (
    category ILIKE '{{ $json.entities?.product_category ?? '' }}'
    OR to_tsvector('english', name) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', '{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? '' }}')
    OR name ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? '' }}' || '%'
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN 'best seller' = ANY(tags) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
LIMIT 3;

-- Â§10.3 Node 2: Fetch best applicable discount rule
-- Best = highest discount value, most specific category match
SELECT
  id, rule_name, product_category, min_quantity, max_quantity,
  discount_type, discount_value, valid_from, valid_to
FROM discount_rules
WHERE
  business_id = '{{ $('Workflow Input').first().json.business_id }}'
  AND is_active = true
  AND min_quantity <= '{{ $('Workflow Input').first().json.entities?.quantity ?? 1 }}'
  AND (max_quantity IS NULL OR max_quantity >= '{{ $('Workflow Input').first().json.entities?.quantity ?? 1 }}')
  AND (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE)
  AND (valid_to   IS NULL OR valid_to   >= CURRENT_DATE)
  AND (
    product_category IS NULL
    OR product_category ILIKE '{{ $('Workflow Input').first().json.entities?.product_category ?? '' }}'
  )
ORDER BY
  -- Category-specific rules rank first
  CASE WHEN product_category IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  -- Then by highest discount value
  discount_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

You are a Delivery Info Extraction AI.
Your job is to read the customer messages and extract the delivery information.

You MUST output your response strictly as a JSON block inside markdown backticks. Do NOT use markdown outside the block.
The JSON must have the exact keys:
- "has_delivery_info": true if they provided their delivery details (address or address + payment), else false
- "delivery_address": the full address text string (e.g., street, city, town, house number) or null
- "payment_method": "cash_on_delivery"
- "customer_name": the customer's full name or null
- "customer_mobile": the mobile phone number or null
- "items": array of objects (each object with "product_name", "qty", "unit_price") extracted from the chat history for the CURRENT order.
- "total_price": total numeric price in LKR.

SPECIAL EXTRACTION RULES:
- If the message has comma-separated or line-separated details like "Name, Address, Payment" or "Name, Mobile, Address, Payment":
  * First part is customer_name.
  * If a phone number (e.g. 07XXXXXXXX or 10 digits) is present, extract it as customer_mobile.
  * The location/town/street part is delivery_address (e.g. "samagibnkj khrat", "123 Main St, Colombo"). NEVER set delivery_address to null if location text is provided!
  * The payment part is payment_method (default to "cash_on_delivery" if cash is mentioned).
  * has_delivery_info MUST be true!

  (business_id, customer_number, reason, chat_snapshot, status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Workflow Input').first().json.business_id }}',
  '{{ $('Workflow Input').first().json.phoneNumber }}',
  CASE

      OR LOWER('{{ $('Workflow Input').first().json.handoff_reason }}') LIKE '%manager%'
